content.value_statement: Blazor apps can render statically before interactivity is ready. This skill shows how RendererInfo guides UI behavior across Server, WebAssembly, WebView, and SSR modes.
actual_capabilities: Explains RendererInfo.IsInteractive and when it changes during prerendering.
Lists common RendererInfo.Name values for Static, Server, WebAssembly, and WebView.
Shows when to disable inputs until interactive rendering starts.
Compares static SSR content with interactive component rendering.
Connects RendererInfo with AssignedRenderMode boundaries in .NET 8 or later.
limitations: Covers RendererInfo concepts only, not full Blazor render mode setup.
Does not include project scaffolding, package installation, or deployment steps.
Assumes .NET 8 or later because RendererInfo is not available before that.
Examples are small guidance snippets, not complete production components.

use_cases.title: Harden Prerendered Forms
use_cases.description: Disable submit actions until Blazor event handlers are active after prerendering.

use_cases.title: Choose Rendered Content
use_cases.description: Show SSR-friendly markup first, then switch to richer interactive components when the runtime is active.

use_cases.title: Debug Render Mode Behavior
use_cases.description: Identify whether a component is running as Static, Server, WebAssembly, or WebView.

prompt_templates.title: Explain RendererInfo Basics
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain RendererInfo.IsInteractive and RendererInfo.Name for a Blazor developer new to .NET 8 render modes.

prompt_templates.title: Guard a Button During Prerendering
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me use RendererInfo.IsInteractive to keep a button disabled until my Blazor component becomes interactive.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Static and Interactive UI
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my component goals and suggest when to render static SSR markup versus an interactive Blazor component using RendererInfo.Name.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Render Mode Decisions
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze a Blazor component architecture and identify where RendererInfo and AssignedRenderMode should guide advanced render mode decisions.

output_examples.input: A Blazor form submits during prerendering and event handlers are not active yet.
output_examples.output: Use RendererInfo.IsInteractive as the gate. Disable interactive controls until the component reports that it is interactive.

output_examples.input: A page should use a simple search form for static SSR and a richer search component later.
output_examples.output: Check RendererInfo.Name for Static. Render SSR-safe markup first, then use the interactive component after the mode changes.

output_examples.input: A hybrid app behaves differently from WebAssembly during component rendering.
output_examples.output: Compare RendererInfo.Name values. Treat WebView as a separate host, and avoid assuming browser-only behavior.

best_practices: Gate event-driven UI with RendererInfo.IsInteractive during prerendering.
Use RendererInfo.Name for broad render context decisions, not feature detection.
Keep static SSR fallbacks simple, accessible, and valid without client interactivity.
anti_patterns: Assuming event handlers work during static server-side rendering.
Treating all interactive modes as equivalent when host behavior matters.
Using RendererInfo as a replacement for full render mode configuration.

faq.question: What does this skill help me build?
faq.answer: It helps you adjust Blazor UI based on RendererInfo.IsInteractive and RendererInfo.Name.

faq.question: Which Blazor versions are covered?
faq.answer: The guidance targets .NET 8 or later, where RendererInfo is available.

faq.question: Does it install packages or run commands?
faq.answer: No. The skill is documentation guidance and does not require command execution.

faq.question: Can it detect the exact assigned render mode?
faq.answer: It points to AssignedRenderMode for assigned mode details and explains RendererInfo runtime context.

faq.question: Is this useful for Blazor Hybrid apps?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes WebView as a RendererInfo.Name value for MAUI, WPF, and WinForms hosts.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill content is compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
